This report assesses selected CYP2C19, SLCO1B1 and DPYD markers for medication implications. Coverage is shown for each gene.

Read the limits, too.

These selected markers do not establish your complete genotype, transporter function or metabolizer status. Consumer raw data can contain errors. Findings are educational and need clinical confirmation before they inform care. Don’t start, stop or change medication based on this tool.

What this version can read

A tab-separated 23andMe text export that declares build 37 and positive-strand genotypes. The reader checks the identifier, chromosome, position and reported bases for eight markers across three genes. Other formats, genome builds, genes, structural variants and copy-number changes are not interpreted.

Files remain in page memory only. Clear the result or close the page when finished. The readable HTML report and technical JSON download contain sensitive findings and are saved only when you request them. No account, analytics or AI service receives your genetic data.
